purpose: Determine whether four common-randomness continuations give reproducible average movement preferences before collecting a larger training teacher. Preserve previous captures; add four streams only, no fitting.
selection: Same lowest TRAIN seed per each of4maps as the closed study. No context, action or fork seed replacement based on outcomes. No development or confirmation use.
controls: Same accepted continuation fork contract atF+1. For each new stream, fork-only reference versus zero-shift full/task-exact control. Four no-fork controls versus original ordinary captures. Native/CUDA and common-state/draw acceptance required; unavailable tails need independent completed raw window evidence, never zero filling.
utility: Unchanged4*alive_goal+0.25*kills-received/100-death, paired against own same-stream control. Observed means and variation, not true expected Q.
analysis: Combine original stream0 and prior1..3 with new4..7. Report all8 utility deltas per action. Compare mean-action rankings of the first4 and second4 streams, top sets tied within0.05, and utility of first-half best action in second half. Fixed candidate order resolves ties:control,left,right,forward,backward,near_stationary.
interpretation: Passing supports only a small four-continuation teacher pilot; failing means four samples are insufficient under these conditions. Eight-sample means are not independently validated by the same eight observations. Next predeclare a fresh TRAIN/development collection with enough repeats or test longer maneuver options; do not tune rejected heads on these four states.
